text: The purpose of this staff report is to report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing and Standards in the matter of an application for a Sidewalk Café permit at 1161 Queen Street East, Berkshire Avenue flankage.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the Sidewalk Café Permit at 1161 Queen Street East for a period of one (1) year from the date of the approval.
